# Vendored Third-Party Assets

This directory contains vendored client-side assets to ensure Hiss can run completely offline without relying on external CDNs.

## Bootstrap

- **Library**: Bootstrap (CSS and JS Bundle)
- **Version**: 5.3.3
- **Origin**: Downloaded from official jsDelivr npm distribution (`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/`)
  - `bootstrap.min.css`: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css`
  - `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` (includes Popper)
- **License**: MIT License (Copyright (c) 2011-2024 The Bootstrap Authors / Twitter, Inc.)
